name: progress-dashboard
description: 進捗管理ダッシュボード: Linear + AI + Surge + Slack のパイプライン

scripts.run-all: npm run fetch-data && npm run calculate-health && npm run ai-suggestions && npm run generate-dashboard && npm run deploy && npm run screenshot && npm run post-slack
scripts.publish-todo-report-html: npm run sync-phone-log && npm run import-phone-log && npm run build-todo-report-data && npm run generate-todo-report && npm run deploy-todo-report
scripts.run-todo-report: npm run check-todo-report-setup && npm run sync-phone-log && npm run import-phone-log && npm run build-todo-report-data && npm run generate-todo-report && npm run deploy-todo-report && npm run send-todo-report-email
scripts.run-todo-report:preview: npm run check-todo-report-setup:preview && npm run sync-phone-log && npm run import-phone-log && npm run build-todo-report-data && npm run generate-todo-report && npm run deploy-todo-report && npm run send-todo-report-email:dry-run
